Hmm, or the path: red1, red2, red3, red4, then back? No.

Hmm. Three candidates. Which to try first?

S2: green R→L: g4=b, g3=N, g2=Y, g1=M → green = M, Y, N, b. Done, failed.

Let me try H3 first: click (37,22) [g1=M] and (37,40) [g4=b], then SPACE.
